item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail

turns.text: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.

item.tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Person and expression: An invented person with a shocked expression; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Headline: ONE LAST TRY
answer_sheet.Platform, size and layout: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9; face on the right and text on the left. Free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Style and background: Bright, punchy gaming style; specific colours and background are your call.

must_haves: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.

turns.text: make me a thumbnail for a gaming challenge

dialog.agent:
What game and challenge is it for? For example, **“Minecraft, but I only have ONE heart”** or **“Fortnite—winning with NO weapons.”**

I’ll make a bold thumbnail with dramatic visuals and big, readable text.

turns.agent:
I picked **Minecraft: “Can I Survive With Only ONE Heart?”** Unfortunately, Magic Hour refused the generation because your account doesn’t have enough credits. No image was created.

The thumbnail concept is ready: a terrified blocky hero facing a creeper over lava, one glowing red heart, and huge **“1 HEART CHALLENGE”** text in yellow and white.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create an eye-catching professional YouTube gaming challenge thumbnail, landscape 16:9. Theme: MINECRAFT BUT I ONLY HAVE ONE HEART. Visually clear Minecraft-inspired voxel game world, vivid blocky graphics. Foreground left: expressive blocky adventurer with brown hair and turquoise shirt, terrified facial expression, holding a diamond sword, dramatic close-up upper body. Right: large menacing green creeper very close to the hero, with orange lava and a few floating blocks behind it. Dark background with brilliant orange lava and electric cyan rim lighting, high contrast, clean composition, thick outlines and dramatic action. Across upper right, huge perfectly legible bold white and yellow text with heavy black outline: '1 HEART' and below it 'CHALLENGE'. A single large bright red pixel-art heart near lower center, remaining hearts dark empty outlines. Keep lettering inside safe margins. Minimal clutter, clear focal point, instantly readable at mobile thumbnail size. No logos, no watermark.
